name: Driver-Side Lane Keeping
author: catpilot
description: Driver-side lane keeping: stabilizes the wheel-to-line gap by damping wander around the model's chosen line (AC stabilizer); conditions the model curvature reference. Hard floors at the extremes. Also carries an optional calibration trim (perception-side yaw DC bias, CalibTrimMode=0/off by default).

LaneKeepDriverSide.description: Which ego lane line to anchor to: left or right
